note: Larkspur's planning numbers for a teaching simulator, not measurements of any real shop. Every rate the A/B testing module shows comes from these, the experiments file and seeded runs.

words.traffic: 400 shoppers a day reach each checkout
words.baseline: 1 in 10 of them buys with today's checkout
words.returns: 1 in 20 orders comes back as a return
words.mde: the team only cares about a change of at least 1 point of conversion
words.level: a difference is called significant when luck alone would give one that big under 5% of the time
